rows.name: try-catch
rows.program: try { acc = 1 } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-catch-no-binding
rows.program: try { acc = 1 } catch { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-catch-caught-throw
rows.program: try { throw { message } } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-catch-coded-throw
rows.program: try { throw { message, code } } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-catch-null-code
rows.program: try { throw { message, code: null } } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-payload-parameter
rows.program: try { throw { message: t } } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-payload-helper-call
rows.program: try { throw { message: lab("x") } } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-catch-return-in-body
rows.program: try { return 5 } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-catch-return-in-catch
rows.program: try { throw { message } } catch (e) { return 6 }

rows.name: try-nested
rows.program: try { try { acc = 1 } catch (i) { acc = 2 } } catch (e) { acc = 3 }

rows.name: for-try-continue
rows.program: for i in 0..3 { try { acc = acc + 1 } catch (e) { continue } }

rows.name: for-try-guarded-continue
rows.program: for i in 0..4 { try { if i == 2 { continue } acc = acc + 1 } catch (e) { acc = acc + 10 } }

rows.name: for-try-break
rows.program: for i in 0..3 { try { acc = acc + 1; break } catch (e) { acc = 2 } }

rows.name: try-for-break
rows.program: try { for i in 0..3 { break } } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-while-in-for-break
rows.program: for o in 0..2 { try { let j = 0; while j < 3 { acc = acc + 1; break } } catch (e) { acc = 2 } }

rows.name: try-await-helper-completes
rows.program: try { acc = later() } catch (e) { acc = 2 }

rows.name: try-finally
rows.program: try { acc = 1 } catch (e) { acc = 2 } finally { acc = 3 }

rows.name: try-finally-no-catch
rows.program: try { acc = 1 } finally { acc = 3 }

rows.name: try-finally-caught-throw
rows.program: try { throw { message } } catch (e) { acc = 2 } finally { acc = 3 }

rows.name: try-finally-return-in-body
rows.program: try { return 5 } catch (e) { acc = 2 } finally { acc = 3 }

rows.name: try-finally-while
rows.program: try { acc = 1 } catch (e) { acc = 2 } finally { let j = 0; while j < 2 { acc = acc + 1; j = j + 1 } }

rows.name: for-inside-finally-bearing-try-break
rows.program: try { for i in 0..3 { acc = acc + 1; break } } catch (e) { acc = 2 } finally { acc = 3 }
